name: Operator Inbox
summary: One queue where your agents ask you questions and request approvals, with the full history and every pending approval in one list.

intents: see everything that waits for my decision

operations.title: Ask the owner
operations.description: Put a question or an approval request in the owner's inbox. Returns an itemId at once; poll inbox_status for the answer. Never treat a missing, expired or unknown answer as approval.

title.description: One line the owner sees in the list.

kind.description: approval: the owner approves or denies; question: the owner answers in words.

context.description: What the owner needs to decide: facts, options, consequences.

responses.description: Allowed answers. approval: a subset of approve, deny, clarify (default all three). question: a subset of answer, clarify (default both).

expiresInS.description: Seconds until the item expires unanswered (default 7 days).

path.description: A page of the CALLING app (e.g. /review/<id>), checked with the shared launch-path rule. The owner sees "Open in <app>" on the item.

open.description: Only for an app caller with a verified product: a page of that app the owner can open from the item. An agent caller, an app without a verified product, or a path the launch rule refuses is refused (the whole call).

family.description: The hold family of what the owner approves: destructive (delete), money, first_contact, identity, public_link, or none. Only an approval with a declared family other than destructive or money can get Approve / Deny buttons in the owner's chat DM; leave it out and the owner decides in Operator Inbox only.

operations.title: Read the owner's answer
operations.description: Read the state of one of your own inbox items: open, answered (with the response and the owner message), expired, or unknown (no such item of yours). Only answered with response approve is an approval.

operations.title: Add to an open item
operations.description: Add a message to one of your own open items (new facts, a correction). The owner sees it before deciding; an answer given on the older text is refused as stale.

operations.title: Withdraw your item
operations.description: Close one of your own open items that is no longer needed, for example because the question was answered somewhere else. Only the caller that raised the item can do this (an app must be the same app instance and product that asked); any other caller gets result unknown, exactly as for an id that does not exist. The item then reads as expired and the owner sees it as withdrawn, with your reason. Calling it again returns the same answer. An item that is already answered or expired answers not_open and is not changed. Never treat a withdrawn item as an approval.

reason.description: Why the item is no longer needed; the owner reads it in the item history.

result.description: withdrawn: the item is closed (also on a repeat). not_open: it was already answered or expired. unknown: no such item of yours.

status.description: The item as inbox_status shows it to you after this call.

operations.title: List inbox items
operations.description: Items for the owner: pending (open, not snoozed; urgent first, then oldest), snoozed, done, or all.

operations.title: Open an item
operations.description: One item with its context, messages, decision, alert deliveries and history (a withdraw by the app or agent that raised it, and refused attempts to withdraw, folded per caller with a count).

url.description: Portal link that opens the raising app at the page it named.

app.description: The raising app's name (from its signed release, via the Portal slice).

open.description: The raising app's page for this item (inbox_ask open), or null when none was given or the Portal link is not known yet.

status.description: next: the item waits for the next digest; the others are the digest DM's state.

at.description: next: about when the next digest is due; else when the digest DM last changed.

digest.description: The alert digest this item is (or will be) part of; null when alerts are not in digest mode and no digest named it.

operations.title: Answer an item
operations.description: Approve, deny, answer or ask for clarification. `version` is the item version you saw; a changed, answered or expired item is refused.

operations.title: Decide from a chat button
operations.description: Connect relays a click on an Approve / Deny button of the owner's Slack or Telegram DM alert. Only Connect can call it. The button value is signed and single-use, and works only for its item and item version, the alert's recipient, and before it expires; anything else is refused and changes nothing.

token.description: The button value as Inbox minted it.

clicker.description: The person who clicked, as the chat service reported it to Connect.

account.description: The account input of the send that carried the buttons (Connect's record of that message).

operations.title: Snooze an item
operations.description: Hide an open item from the pending list until a time (ISO 8601, in the future, at most 30 days); null wakes it now.

operations.title: Change priority
operations.description: Set the priority of an open item.

operations.title: Mark as seen
operations.description: Tell the agent that the owner has seen an open item (it reads seenByOwner).

operations.title: Pending approvals
operations.description: Everything that waits for the owner: open Inbox items and, with your consent, the pending holds of all apps. Each row opens the owning app where you decide.

openUrl.description: Portal link that opens the owning app at decidePath (null until the workspace slice names Portal).

operations.title: Read alert settings
operations.description: The owner alert setting: off (default), a Buzz DM, or a channel DM through Connect.

delivery.description: each: one DM per new item (default). digest: one DM per window with the count and the titles.

digestEveryMin.description: Digest window in minutes (default 60). Used only with delivery digest.

start.description: Local time HH:MM (24 h) when quiet starts.

end.description: Local time HH:MM when quiet ends; may be after midnight.

quietHours.description: No alert DM is sent in this daily window (in timeZone); alerts wait until it ends. null = off (default).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the owner (e.g. Europe/Berlin). Required when quietHours is set.

operations.title: Change alert settings
operations.description: Turn the owner alert DM on or off. The DM goes out through Connect. Only the first DM to a new person waits for the owner's approval (unless the owner turned on approval for every message). Optional: a digest instead of one DM per item, and quiet hours in the owner's time zone.

buttons.description: Approve / Deny buttons in the channel DM (Slack, Telegram) for approvals that may be decided from the chat. Off by default; only with dm = channel.

companions.purpose: Optional owner alert: a direct message when an agent puts a new item in the inbox (off by default; the first message to you waits for your approval in Connect).
See the pending approvals of all apps in one list (you consent at deploy; deciding stays in each app).
